final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.transref AS tr, t.tradekind AS tk, AVG(c.prevviol) AS ga FROM compliancecase c JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = c.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY c.transref, t.tradekind), o AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM g), r AS (SELECT g.tr, g.tk, g.ga, g.ga / o.oa AS ratio FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL AND o.oa <> 0), a AS (SELECT tk, AVG(ratio) AS ta FROM r GROUP BY tk), k AS (SELECT r.ga, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.ta AS diff FROM r JOIN a ON r.tk = a.tk WHERE r.ratio > a.ta) SELECT AVG(ga) AS avg_group_prevviol, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
